messages:
maria_cs: Hi @andrew_sec + team — Jensen from BrightBank pinged asking for completed CAIQ sections + KMS/HSM evidence. They want answers by next Tue but asked if we can get an extension to EOW. They also reported an auth error when pulling audit logs: 

maria_cs: "When I try to download the audit bundle it returns 403: Forbidden, customer says 'token invalid'"

customer_jensen: Thanks for the quick help — we hit a 403 when calling /v1/audit/export, gist of error: `{"error":"unauthorized","code":401}`. We rotated our API key earlier today, could that be related? Also need HSM attestation pdf and CAIQ baseline answers by EOW if possible.

saira_support: @customer_jensen thx — can you confirm the exact API key id you used? If you rotated, the old key would fail; new key should work. Also I can trigger a fresh audit export on our side and share a signed bundle. Can you paste the request id from the response headers?

customer_jensen: header: X-Request-Id: r-4f7b9123. We used key id kb-rot-2025-03. Trying new key still 403 though.

kevin_eng: @saira_support I pulled logs for r-4f7b9123 — looks like token auth failed at our proxy layer with an expired jwk cache. Workaround: hit /v1/keys/refresh or wait ~60s. I'll add a safer cache invalidation path. For immediate repro, run:

```
# on your side, curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <NEW_KEY>" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export" -v
```

kevin_eng: Also sending exact log snippet: `auth_failed: token_kid_not_found, source=proxy-1, trace=r-4f7b9123`

andrew_sec: For the CAIQ/HSM evidence — we can provide the HSM attestation PDF and KMS key lifecycle docs. @maria_cs do we have an up-to-date KMS rotation matrix and HSM vendor attestation in the secure bucket? I think the latest attestation is from 2024-11.

maria_cs: Yes — secure-bucket/redwood-compliance/attestations/hsm_attestation_2024-11.pdf exists. I uploaded a signed copy of our standard CAIQ answers: secure-bucket/redwood-compliance/caiq/redwood_caiq_answers_v2.csv (contains QIDs and brief answers). I can share one-time links.

andrew_sec: Also need an explicit data retention table for hosted API logs vs audit bundles. I pushed a short doc: secure-bucket/redwood-compliance/retention_table_2025-01.md — includes retention periods and deletion controls.

maria_cs: Customer asked for extension — requested new due date Tue 2025-06-10. I proposed EOW (2025-05-23) as alternative. @andrew_sec can we commit to EOW for baseline CAIQ + HSM attestation + KMS rotation doc?

andrew_sec: EOW is tight but doable for baseline answers + attestation + rotation doc. For bespoke questions they added (paperwork on key custody and cross-border crypto exports) we'll need 3 more business days. Recommend we accept EOW for core deliverables and ask for extension on bespoke items.

saira_support: Action items: 1) Saira to resend one-time signed links for attestation + CAIQ CSV to customer_jensen (today). 2) Kevin to add cache-bust endpoint and follow up on auth 403 (ETA tomorrow). 3) Andrew to draft retention snippet + confirm HSM attestation date (ETA EOD). 4) Maria to request formal extension for bespoke items to Tue 2025-06-10.

maria_cs: Sending extension request now: "Hi Jensen — we can deliver the CAIQ baseline, HSM attestation, and KMS rotation doc by 2025-05-23. For the bespoke custody/export questions we need until 2025-06-10. Please confirm if that works." :pray: 

customer_jensen: That timeline works. Please send the audit bundle when available (we need it for our compliance folder). Also can you include the MD5 of the bundle?

kevin_eng: Will attach audit bundle and md5 once I trigger export from the system. For reference, I triggered re-export r-4f7b9123-retry at 1799991255 — bundle stored at s3://rb-audits/r-4f7b9123-retry.tar.gz md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e. If customer still sees 403 on their side, ask them to retry after rotating the key cache by calling the refresh endpoint or wait 60s.

audit-bot: Incident INC-2025-042 created (auth cache miss) — assignee: kevin_eng — priority: P3 — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2025-042

saira_support: Sent one-time links to customer_jensen (links expire in 72h). Marking this thread: needs final sign-off once customer confirms receipt. :white_check_mark: 

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer success ticket with these deliverables and extension confirmation.

customer_jensen: Received bundle and documents, thanks team. I'll close on our side after internal review. :thumbsup:
